title: Replace the false finite-auxiliary-class inference by an exact neutral solve
statement: The audit preserves the counterexample 0->A+B->3A+2B->0: a neutral finite halo may have all delta=0 while infinitely many physical states in one class reconnect outside it. In a neutral component Q(r), split I=component intersect J and O=outside. If O is nonempty, set v_O=1 and v_I=(-Q_II^T)^(-1)[1+Q_OI^T 1], earning exactly (Q^T v)_I=-1, with positive outside feedback explicitly present. If O is empty the component is a closed finite PHYSICAL class at fixed r and is excluded from a fixed infinite-class strict drift assertion. An infinite union of finite classes is not a finite head; inactive phases or empty I do not give strict drift. The repaired conclusion is classwise negative drift at large corner count for a prechosen alpha, not global recurrence.
